subject: Fwd: Acme AI — Series A intro
text:
Hey team,

Forwarding the intro below — Acme AI is raising a $5M Series A led by Sequoia, with Greylock participating. Founders are Alice (CEO, ex-OpenAI) and Bob (CTO, ex-Anthropic). Deck is attached.

Worth a closer look.

— A
